powerpoint: Create a new editable three-slide practice deck: title Practice, content Sales, and closing Thank you. Use practice.png for insertion; a 3-row by 2-column table contains Item/Value, A/10, B/20. Use column chart values A=10 and B=20. Add notes Say hello. Save exports as practice-slides.pdf in a new Practice Outputs folder.
excel: Create a worksheet with A1:C4 = Item, Units, Price / A, 2, 10 / B, 3, 20 / C, 4, 15. Reserve E1=0.1 for a fixed rate and empty F:H cells for results. Expected units sum=9, average=3. Use IF Units>=3 then High else Low; XLOOKUP B returns 20 from Price; dropdown choices Open,Closed. CSV fixture preserves IDs 001 and 002. Use a new output sheet.
word: Create a two-page practice document with heading Overview, subsection Details, paragraphs of synthetic text and a third-page Appendix section. Use practice.png, a 3x2 table, and a supplied synthetic source: author Example Author, title Practice Book, year 2024, publisher Practice Press. Track changing draft to reviewed. Start Appendix page numbering at 1.
capcut: Create a 10-second practice clip from synthetic graphics with spoken counting recorded by the tester. Keep seconds 2-8 for trimming; arrange two copies; overlay a circle at seconds 3-5; animate scale 100 to 120 percent; caption the actual spoken language. For blur use a consenting tester or synthetic moving face and inspect every frame. Export practice-video.mp4.
figma: Create an editable web Design file with two 390x844 frames Home and Details, a card containing label Learn and button Open. Make default and hover button variants, a local color variable, and use practice.png inside an ellipse mask. Use 16-pixel card padding and 8-pixel gap. Prototype Open to Details; export Home as 1x PNG.
canva: Create a three-page editable web presentation using synthetic text Practice, Details, Thanks and practice.png. Use a free ellipse frame, blue #2457A7, and an available font. For timing/audio use a separate 10-second video design with title visible seconds 2-5 and practice.wav at 0-5. Use only available account assets; request PNG or an accessible unflattened PDF.
fl_studio: Create a disposable 120 BPM four-bar project using installed stock instruments. Use kick beats 1 and 3, snare beats 2 and 4; a four-note C4-E4-G4-C5 phrase; route kick and bass to named Mixer tracks. Create a unique second pattern, automate a native volume parameter, and export 44.1 kHz WAV to Practice Outputs. For recording use a permitted input and retain previous takes.
photoshop: Open practice.png and duplicate the source. Use a circle shape and title Practice on separate editable layers. Apply a masked brightness adjustment, a reversible blur Smart Filter and one small retouch correction on a new layer. For hair-edge testing use a tester-owned permitted photo rather than pretending the geometric fixture contains hair. Save a layered practice.psd and transparent PNG copy.
illustrator: Create a 600x400 practice artboard with two overlapping circles, one curved Pen outline, text Practice and placed practice.png. Use a global blue #2457A7 swatch, ellipse clipping mask and a duplicate live trace before expanding. Add a second named artboard Detail; deliver SVG or PDF copies while retaining practice.ai.
premiere: Create a 1920x1080 30 fps practice sequence from tester-created local footage. Multicam needs two short views of a visible clap with shared audible clap; do not use unrelated audio. Keep source folders intact, create proxies separately, and move only a duplicate source for the relink case. Use spoken English counting for captions and export a 10-second MP4.
after_effects: Create a 1920x1080 30 fps 5-second composition with two shape layers. Animate one position from x=200 to x=1000 between seconds 0 and 2; keep its y fixed. Use an ellipse matte, a null parent and an RGB+Alpha render. For tracking use a tester-created high-contrast moving square clip with a known occlusion interval.
finder: Create a disposable Practice Files folder containing practice.png, practice.pdf and notes.txt. Use new subfolder Lesson Files, tag Practice and archive only these fixtures. Retain originals for copy and ZIP checks. Do not use personal Downloads content.
preview: Open two generated PDFs practice-a.pdf and practice-b.pdf. Duplicate every participating PDF before editing. Merge A then B into practice-merged.pdf, annotate the copy with Reviewed, convert practice.png to JPEG and compress only a PDF copy. Preserve and compare the original files.
safari: Use a permitted test page with a known downloadable practice file. Record its URL, expected filename and actual browser download setting. Use a new Practice Outputs folder and a distinct practice-page.pdf name. Do not run downloaded executables.
terminal: Use only a disposable Practice Files directory containing notes.txt. Run pwd, ls -la, mkdir "Lesson Files", cp -i "notes.txt" "notes-copy.txt", mv -i "notes-copy.txt" "notes-moved.txt", and find "." -name "notes*.txt" as separate reviewed exercises. Demonstrate interruption with sleep 30. Never use sudo, recursive deletion or personal files.
